#  13368 - English B2.1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13368**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **English B2.1**  |  
|  Englisch B2.1   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * D'Onofrio, Gabriella 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | In this module, the participants are enabled to understand complex texts on concrete and abstract topics and to communicate so spontaneously and fluently that a normal conversation with native speakers is possible without great effort on both sides. You will learn to express yourself clearly and in detail on a wide range of topics, to explain a point of view on a topical issue and to state the advantages and disadvantages of various options. (Compare can-do descriptions of GER B2)Finally, the participants reflect on the culture in the English-speaking area in the context of the content conveyed and, after completing the module, will understand the basics and customs of the forms of life in the English-speaking area.  |  
| Contents:  |  **Action-oriented tasks** for global, selective and detailed listening and reading comprehension, for the production of topic- and situation-related written texts, for topic- and situation-related oral expression as well as exercises for understanding and consolidating linguistic structures (vocabulary and grammar). Furthermore, learning strategies and techniques for self-study are imparted and trained.Thematical and grammatical focus: 
  * Information will be given at course start

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Strongly recommended: Module English B1.2 or English language skills at level GER B1 The existing knowledge of English is checked with an entrance test at the beginning of the semester.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | New Language Leader Upper-Intermediate Coursebook (ISBN 978-1-4479-6155-0)Complementary materials via Moodle Learning Platform  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 5 topic-related tasks or/and tests of 45 - 60 minutes minutes each (each counting 20% for the module grade)  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Mathematik / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * The existing knowledge of English is checked with an entrance test at the beginning of the semester.
  * This modul especially aims at students in all study programs, who aspire a semester abroad, or exchange students with an English language competence at level CEFR B1. It is **not** **suitable** for students with a lower or level of language competence


  * **Online enrolment/Moodle**


  * In exceptional cases, the face-to-face course can be held as an online live session.

 |  
| Module Components:  | Exercise English B2.1 (4hpw each winter term)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
